answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and posts each result with a pearl receipt on the ledge; the receipt seal binds it to that agent bond key. A violet panel recomputes the result from the receipt inputs before payment: a mismatch burns the bond and voids the receipt; a match returns it after one clean epoch. Each fake locks 70 and pays a 20 fee, so the k-th fake risks 90, or 110 on a second run after a mismatch; 1,000 fakes put 90,000 at risk. A rented-receipt ring fails: a borrowed seal mismatches the submitter bond, burning it and voiding the receipt. An honest agent pays the 20 fee once.
